category: assurance gate checks words, not meaning
summary: The decision-alignment gate is a doc-wording lint (phrase presence / forbidden regex); only params, protocol hash and reason codes touch code; no gate covers D076-D114.
expected: A 'docs<->code' gate checks that src follows the governing rows, or is described as a doc lint.
actual: Contradicting doc text containing the required phrases passes (OR-08, OR-01a); D076-D114 (execution model) are not referenced by any gate; ALL_PASS says nothing about src.
impact: Owner may read ALL_PASS as proof docs and code agree; drift in src/execution and src/live is not caught by it.
evidence: Probe tmp/scripts_tooling/p1_gate_strings.py: ('OR-08', True, 'ok') and ('OR-01a', True, 'ok') on contradicting text; grep of D-numbers in scripts/decision_alignment stops at D075.
why_tests_miss: tests/test_decision_alignment_* test that a removed phrase is detected, i.e. the lint itself.
recommendation: Describe it as a doc lint; add code-reading checks for money/safety rows (import the constant/enum/config as params.py does) and extend to D076+.

category: owner tool runs against a live process; check and writes not atomic
rule: RUNBOOK 22 rehearsal procedure step 2; demo_clear docstring
summary: demo_clear checks unresolved intents in a separate connection, then expires plans and writes SAFE_MODE off in separate calls, and never checks that the live process is stopped.
expected: Refuse while the live process is up (fresh liveness stamp) or do check and writes in one transaction; RUNBOOK says to stop the live service first.
actual: A CONFIRM between the check and the EXPIRED transition can send a Demo entry for a plan the script then expires; a running process keeps SAFE_MODE in memory while the row says off.
impact: Demo only: inconsistent rehearsal state / void smoke; no mainnet path.
evidence: demo_clear.py:115-133 (separate engine.connect() check, then build_pg_stores, transitions and journal rows); no liveness check; RUNBOOK steps 1-3 do not say stop the live service before demo_clear.
why_tests_miss: tests/test_demo_clear.py exercises clear_open_plans/exit_safe_mode with fakes; main() and concurrency not exercised.
recommendation: Refuse when the live liveness stamp is fresh; add 'stop the live service' to RUNBOOK step 2.
known_prior: G-0503 (direct SAFE_MODE write, env-var-only Demo guard) not repeated

category: soak evaluator passes on a journal that does not show a soak
rule: plans 25-07/25-24/25-25 (Demo soak, D040); compare D061/D063 paper-soak coverage rule
summary: Window = first..last journal row with no coverage/gap criterion; no-order and null round-trip journals pass; export window free; image_commit never checked.
expected: Fail on material downtime (gap rule like D061/D063), require journal start at registration, compare running revision with image_commit.
actual: Two healthy HEALTH_VERDICT rows 22 days apart give overall PASS (round_trips SKIPPED).
impact: The Demo soak PASS is the gate evidence before mainnet; it can PASS without proving continuous healthy operation.
evidence: Probe tmp/scripts_tooling/p2_soak_two_rows.py: passed True, all criteria PASS; compute_window l.658-671; check_order_after_registration PASS when no orders l.622-628; check_round_trips SKIPPED when null l.822-829.
why_tests_miss: tests/test_evaluate_demo_soak.py uses dense journals; no sparse journal or late --since case.
recommendation: Add a max-gap coverage criterion with a ratified threshold, start-at-registration check, image_commit check; make zero trades non-passing.

category: soak criterion cannot see the defect it is named after
rule: D080 / AGENTS.md 'a placement is never re-sent'; soak criterion duplicate_entry
summary: LIVE_PLACEMENT_OUTCOME ids are deterministic per approval and the journal inserts ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, so a second send for one approval can never produce a second row; journal failures are swallowed.
expected: Count sends from execution_intents or exchange order history per approval.
actual: Journal half of the criterion is structurally 0 for one-approval-two-sends; only reconcile DOUBLED_POSITION/DUPLICATE_EXCHANGE_ID (filled or open at a tick) can show it.
impact: An unfilled duplicate cancelled/expired before a tick leaves no trace; soak PASS overstates D080 evidence.
evidence: src/live/execution_service.py:264-272, 301-329 (correlated_event_id over approval id, step 'outcome'), 338-346 (exceptions swallowed); src/persistence/journal.py:98-115 (on_conflict_do_nothing + _verify_replay); tests write two outcome rows with distinct ids by hand (tests/test_evaluate_demo_soak.py:750-760).
reproduction: Code read of the cited lines.
why_tests_miss: Test journals are hand-built with ids the real producer cannot emit.
recommendation: Export and count execution_intents per approval, or journal per-send rows with a send counter.

category: evaluator exit code ignores proof class
rule: SC9 fake evidence never closes PAPER-01; fail closed
summary: A fixture-source (FAKE) bundle that meets the criteria exits 0; the proof class only adds a text note.
expected: Non-REAL_SOAK bundles exit with a distinct non-zero code.
actual: EXIT_PASS when evaluation.passed regardless of proof_class.
impact: A wrapper keyed on exit code would accept fixture evidence; owner reading the text sees the note.
evidence: exit_criteria.py:174-175 passed ignores proof_class; l.185-188 note only; evaluate_trial_soak.py:161.
reproduction: Code read of the cited lines.
why_tests_miss: Exit code for a FAKE bundle not asserted (not exhaustively checked).
recommendation: Dedicated exit code when proof_class is not REAL_SOAK.
